about: PhD in Economics and Assistant Professor at the School of Digital Technologies, Narxoz University. Since 2000, I have combined teaching, research and continuous technical development.
I work with Python, PHP, JavaScript, SQL and modern AI tools. I teach databases, Oracle SQL, web technologies, internet application development and discrete mathematics.
